div.head: Iudex 6
div.ab: Forðon þonne ondræde he him God, his deman, ðy læs he eft on domes dæge beforan Godes eagum weorðe dumb ⁊ genyðerad.
Timeat omnis iudex ac diligat Deum, iudicem suum, ne in die iudicii mutus fiat et humiliatus ante oculos iudicis cuncta uidentis!
Darum also fürchte er Gott, seinen Richter, damit er nicht später am [jüngsten] Gerichtstage vor Gottes Augen stumm werde und verdammt.
Therefore let him fear God, his judge, lest later on the [Last] Day of Judgment he become dumb and condemned before God's eyes.
Therefore let him fear God, his judge, lest later before the eyes of God on the [last] day of judgement he be made dumb and condemned.
div.note: U: translator unrecorded: check; Isidore, Sent. III 52.5.

note.seg: Vgl. Gl Jüngstes Gericht. Unter Drohung mit diesem laut desselben Matthäus-Spruches mahnt zur Gerechtigkeit auch Blickling Homil. 61
